title: A natural position
content: "Never paint a portrait as though the person were posing. A natural position can only be kept for a few seconds, it is like a flash of lightning. You must just put down a few large marks for the chosen position of head, hands, feet, etc., and keep fitting the sitter into them."Quote from Charles Lasar, Practical Hints for Art Students, (Duffield & Company, New York, 1923Drawing by John Singer Sargent.
